$comment: What this extension builds from. A bump is a PR; docs/PACKAGING.md says how. opentide.version is the opentide CI tests the extension against (a user's own opentide, tiers 1-3). wasi, highlights and engine are assets of opentide releases.

opentide.$comment: The opentide CI's real-opentide and integration tests install (pip install opentide==<version>).

wasi.$comment: The opentide CLI compiled to wasm32-wasip1, one module for every platform: tier 4, the runtime when no opentide is installed. An asset of opentide's release from rc.3 on. sha256 is the module's line in that release's SHA256SUMS. It is a PLACEHOLDER until rc.3 is released: scripts/wasi.mjs and npm run build refuse it (docs/PACKAGING.md says how to set it).

engine.$comment: The opentide language server built for WebAssembly (wasm-bindgen --target web): tier 5, editor features with nothing installed and in Restricted Mode, and the engine of the web extension. From the same opentide release as the highlights zip.
